reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.reason: A second reading of the explicit member enumeration exposed two different uses of economic language. A batch, setup, feedback or platform has its own costs; that does not make it a general economic appraisal of every other control. Conversely every selected positive owner explicitly carries a cheap path and application/control burden, so a genuine improvement/portfolio/lifecycle economic appraisal has an actual receiving use when that owner's optional implementation is the very work being appraised. This is a correction of the navigation map, not a new duty to perform a cost programme.
source_record.receiving_scope: For all positive owners in the refined index, control_economics denotes only the actual selection, maintenance, simplification or retirement of that owner's implementation, using its exact native cheap path and selected incremental/total-cost field. A cost estimate for a different activity has no receiving use. Source economics may recommend retaining the existing method or completing the minimum binding function. It cannot waive a nontradeable obligation, give authority, prove the control works or imply a numeric optimum.

additional_explicit_interfaces.argument: Actual headroom in the build/test resource used to maintain the reproducible candidate can prevent its evidence path being unavailable under variable work. This is the same resource-availability premise, not a technical passing claim. The loading policy must produce suitable timely capacity rather than merely report utilization.
additional_explicit_interfaces.guard: The identified resource and queue actually constrain the candidate preparation/evidence path; include pre-entry backlog and independent work.
additional_explicit_interfaces.counter: A utilization target for another resource supplies no readiness; steady predictable work may legitimately operate at high utilization.

additional_explicit_interfaces.argument: Actual system-level ownership and delivered resources can remove a cross-boundary obstacle in the candidate build/configuration/verification path. This is a specific execution premise, not proof that allocated funds turn into capability or that leadership can approve exposure without the real right.
additional_explicit_interfaces.guard: Name the candidate's actual missing resource/interface owner and establish that the intervention delivers that needed function.
additional_explicit_interfaces.counter: A budget entry or leadership meeting without the required capability changes no readiness; a sound candidate still needs its other evidence.

source_record.negative_control: The structurally plausible EA10->EL010 identity match stays examined unresolved. Extending genuine economic appraisal to an explicitly cost-bearing implementation does not repair that different object/measurement mismatch.
source_record.initial_transport_failures: The first assemble_whole_analysis.py run expected a nonexistent Agile overlay native-id field and stopped before writing native evidence. After exact nested native.expected_native_id/canonical_key binding was repaired, the second run found the projection uses directions, not rows. It had written only derived evidence/index files and no scientific projection. Both failures are retained in this record; no predecessor program was rerun. The third run produced the first unprojected 1730M/1970U author table, now superseded by this explicitly reasoned refinement.
source_record.forecast_economic_scope: A relevant outside-view forecast can qualify the cost/range of an actual optional implementation; it still does not create capacity or forecast the cost of an unrelated control.
